one_liner.zh: 通过 DSH 工具启动 ChatGPT Codex OAuth 登录，为 openai-codex 模型提供方写入凭据。
one_liner.en: Starts ChatGPT Codex OAuth sign-in through a DSH tool and stores credentials for the openai-codex provider.

local: The browser must run on the same machine as the harness for the localhost OAuth callback.

completeness.reason: Tool implements start, status, code submission and cancellation, but delegates OAuth itself to the host authorization flow.

code.reason: The single module has clear tool/action structure and handles missing services and flow errors.

docs.reason: README explains the tool, credential record, installation and account requirements.

maintenance.reason: The repository list records one commit and a single initial push date.

tests.reason: No tests are present in this six-file repository.

quality.notes: Lite route; implementation-level scores reflect the inspected entry module.
